_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/combat/test_batched_combat_damage.py. t_bcd_flock is the filtered batch trigger -- 'one or more Wyrms you control' -- and draws once however many connect; t_bcd_perconnection is the near miss written on the per-connection event, kept live as the contrast that fires N times for N creatures. t_bcd_players_only is the unwidened batch trigger, the control that proves a battle-only swing does not fire every existing card using this event; t_bcd_or_battle is the same line with 'or battle'. t_bcd_bounce points a return_to_hand at the damagers binding, which is how 'one of those Wyrms' is shown to name the filtered subset. t_bcd_wyrm and t_bcd_elf are the bodies: one matches the filter, one does not.
